abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and device for automatically generating a patent retrieval report. The method comprises the steps that information of the scheme and at least one patent comparison file are obtained; performing text extraction on the patent comparison file to obtain text units; performing fragmentation splitting processing on the text unit to obtain information units with different granularities; inputting the information unit into a contrastive analysis model obtained by pre-training to obtain a contrastive analysis result; generating report content according to the patent comparison file, the scheme information and the comparison analysis result; and filling the report content and the related information into a retrieval report template to generate a patent retrieval report. By means of the scheme, the efficiency and accuracy of retrieval report generation can be improved.

abstract_en: The invention relates to an artificial intelligence-based patent analysis method, system and device and a storage medium, and the method comprises the steps: inputting a patent text into a patent feature extraction model, and obtaining a technical field, technical features and technical problems; acquiring a patent application number corresponding to the technical field based on the first scoring model, constructing and based on a number curve, determining a life cycle, and outputting a first scoring value; based on a second scoring model, obtaining the number of related patents of an associated two-tuple generated by the technical features and the technical problems, and outputting a second scoring value; the second scoring model obtains a patent comparison file based on an associated triple generated by the technical field, the technical feature and the technical problem; the third scoring model performs stability analysis on the patent text based on the patent comparison file text, and outputs a third scoring value; performing weighted fusion processing on the obtained score values, and outputting an analysis result of the to-be-analyzed patent; compared with the prior art, the technical scheme of the invention can improve the accuracy and efficiency of patent analysis.

abstract_en: The invention provides a patent comparative analysis method. According to the patent comparative analysis method, a patent database is established by utilizing a network technology; a candidate phraseset of the patent document set is established based on a word segmentation technology; an important phrase set is extracted on the basis of an optimization method, similarity scores and difference scores of important phrases and target patents and comparison patents are calculated, a similar phrase set and a difference phrase set of the target patents and the comparison patents are extracted on the basis of the optimization method, and patent comparative analysis is rapidly and effectively achieved.

abstract_en: The invention discloses an intellectual property right protection system. The system comprises an information acquisition module, an intellectual property information classification module, an intellectual property system review module, a manual review module, a right protection management platform, an artificial lawyer online consultation module, an evidence collection module, a right protection module and a tracking module. According to the intellectual property right protection system, after customer files are classified, the customer files are quickly examined through a copyright file comparison module, a patent file comparison module and an image comparison module which are included in an intellectual property system examination module. The examination efficiency and accuracy can be improved; a manual examination mode is used to determine the repetition rate of the file again, and the fairness of comparison review is ensured to the greatest extent; according to the system, a rights protection management platform, an artificial lawyer online consultation module, an evidence collection module, a rights protection module and a tracking module are arranged, rights protection processing is carried out on clients with missing legal knowledge, and rights and interests of the clients are maximized.

abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for searching a comparison file of a target patent, a server and a terminal, and relates to the technical field of patent invalidation. Comparison file information needing to search for the target patent comprises a combination of at least one certain right technical feature in the target patent; comparison file suspected information which is sent by at least one second client and corresponds to the searched target patent is received. The suspected information is sent to a first client and/or a third client. The invention has the beneficial effects that the method for searching the comparison file of the target patent is creatively provided, and the comparison file needing to search the target patent is found out in the form of a broadcaster net; different tasks are sent according to specific requirements, so that the searching efficiency and accuracy can be improved; more people, especially agents, participate in invalid work, the writing level is indirectly improved, and the patent quality is improved to a certain extent.

applicant: BEIJING HENGGUAN NETWORK DATA PROC CO LTD
abstract_en: The invention discloses a patent personalized retrieval analysis system based on big data. The system comprises a retrieval module, a personalization module and an analysis module. The personalized module serves the retrieval module and the analysis module; the personalized module comprises a user model unit, a data acquisition unit, a learning unit, a reminding unit and a storage unit, the retrieval module comprises a field distinguishing unit, a keyword searching unit and a theme unit, and the analysis module comprises an automatic distribution unit, a file comparison unit, a duplicate checking unit and an innovation level analysis unit. According to the present invention, patents are evaluated and analyzed from many aspects, for example including the manual judgment and the systematic duplicate checking, so that patent analysis has subjectivity and objectivity, and the patent analysis is more comprehensive. By carrying out the personalized analysis from the aspects, such as the user habits, the historical behaviors, etc., the requirements of the user are better known, and the latest trend of patents in the field is known in time through the attention of the user and by pushing the related information.
